maddeler.e: زَرْكَشَ • (zarkaša) Iq (non-past يُزَرْكِشُ (yuzarkišu), verbal noun زَرْكَشَة (zarkaša))
maddeler.t: Borrowed from Middle Persian [Term?], and denominal verb. Persian زرکش (zarkaš), whence Middle Armenian զառքաշ (zaṙkʻaš), Middle Georgian ზარქაში (zarkaši).
g: to adorn, to decorate, to embellish
